title: Restricted Fourier weight identity
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $S\subseteq J$. If $Z$ is a uniform sign assignment outside $J$ and $Y,Y'$ are independent uniform sign assignments on $J$, then the expected restricted Fourier weight observation is the restricted Fourier weight of $f$ at $J,S$.
hypotheses_covered: Independent uniform assignments on the coordinates in $J$ and outside $J$
